sources.entry: Mybucks.online - Secure, browser-based, password-only self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Nodejs

summary.one_liner: A browser-based, seedless crypto wallet that derives a private key from a passphrase and PIN using Scrypt and Keccak256, with no storage or accounts.
summary.what_it_does: The app generates an EVM private key in the browser from a user-entered passphrase and PIN, using the Scrypt KDF (N=131072, r=8, p=1) and Keccak256 hashing, with no seed phrase or registration. Nothing is stored; closing or refreshing the page discards the wallet. The README describes checking balances and sending and receiving assets, using Infura and Alchemy for EVM networks and TronWeb for Tron, with ERC20 tokens filtered to the Uniswap default token list. It also supports sending a wallet as a URL so a recipient can take ownership of it. The core key-generation and transfer-link logic is published separately as the @mybucks.online/core npm package.
use_cases: Create a disposable crypto wallet without a seed phrase
Send stablecoins or tokens to someone as a gift link
Distribute tokens in bulk through shareable URLs
Open a wallet in a browser without installing an app
Study how passphrase and PIN derive an Ethereum-style private key
how_to_run: Update the .env variables with valid Infura, Alchemy and Trongrid API keys
notable: Seedless key derivation from passphrase and PIN using Scrypt and Keccak256, with no seed phrase
Wallet transfer via URL, so a recipient can take ownership without sharing an address
Zero footprint: no servers, databases, storage or tracking, all in the browser
Core key generation and transfer-link logic published as a separate npm package
caveats: Requires free API keys from Infura, Alchemy and Trongrid to run locally
The README describes the app as deployed on GitHub Pages; there is no stated server-side component
Losing or forgetting the passphrase and PIN means the wallet cannot be recovered, since nothing is stored
